profile.summary:
tbertran demonstrates **Mid-level JavaScript expertise** primarily focused on **frontend development**, with specialized contributions to **Chart.js**, a popular data visualization library. Their work shows strong proficiency in **DOM manipulation, event-driven programming, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)**. While contributions are currently limited to **frontend-only** JavaScript (no backend or TypeScript exposure), their contributions to Chart.js indicate familiarity with **OOP patterns, modular design, and performance optimizations** in client-side applications.

Key strengths include:
- **Chart.js internals** (Canvas rendering, event handling, accessibility improvements)
- **Vanilla JavaScript** (DOM updates, prototype-based OOP)
- **Modern JS features** (likely arrow functions, classes, destructuring, etc.)
- **Feature-focused contributions** (clean, modular code with attention to accessibility)

No evidence of **backend development, TypeScript, or advanced testing frameworks** in this dataset. Further contributions outside Chart.js would be needed to assess broader JavaScript expertise.
